# Range of quintiles for PFAS
```{r quintiles}
df_long_final %>%
  group_by(pfoa_quin) %>%
  summarise(min = min(pfoa, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(pfoa, na.rm = TRUE))

df_long_final %>%
  group_by(pfos_quin) %>%
  summarise(min = min(pfos, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(pfos, na.rm = TRUE))

df_long_final %>%
  group_by(pfna_quin) %>%
  summarise(min = min(pfna, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(pfna, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#pfna tertiles
df_long_final <- df_long_final |>
  mutate(pfna_tert = ntile(pfna, 3),
         pfna_bin = ntile(pfna, 2))

df_long_final %>%
  group_by(pfna_tert) %>%
  summarise(min = min(pfna, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(pfna, na.rm = TRUE))

df_long_final %>%
  group_by(pfna_bin) %>%
  summarise(min = min(pfna, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(pfna, na.rm = TRUE))

```

# Creating new categories for PFNA
```{r}
df_long_final <- df_long_final |>
  mutate(pfna_cat = factor(case_when(pfna < 2 ~ 1,
                                     pfna >=2 & pfna < 3.8 ~ 2, 
                                     pfna >= 3.8 ~ 3)) )

df_long_final %>%
  group_by(pfna_cat) %>%
  summarise(min = min(pfna, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(pfna, na.rm = TRUE))
```





# Table 1s

```{r table 1s filter, include=FALSE}
# filter to just first row (at diagnosis)
df_table1_diagnosis <- df_long_final |>
  filter(
    overlap_start <= newdxdt,
    newdxdt <= overlap_end
  ) %>%
  distinct(patient_study_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# recoding unknown/missing as their category
df_table1_diagnosis <- df_table1_diagnosis |>
  mutate(insur.f = factor(case_when(is.na(insur.f) ~ "Unknown",
                                    TRUE ~ insur.f),
                          levels = c("Uninsured", "Private", "Medicaid", "Medicare", "Other government", "Unknown")),
         grade_combo.f = factor(case_when(is.na(grade_combo.f) ~ "Unknown",
                                      TRUE ~ grade_combo.f),
                            levels = c("<7", "7+", "Unknown")),
         stage.f = factor(case_when(is.na(stage.f) ~ "Unknown",
                                    TRUE ~ stage.f),
                          levels = c("Localized", "Regional", "Distant", "Unknown")),
         mets = factor(case_when(is.na(mets) ~ "Unknown",
                                 mets==0 ~ "No",
                                 mets==1 ~ "Yes" ),
                       levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),
         txsurg.f = factor(case_when(is.na(txsurg.f) ~ "Unknown",
                                     TRUE ~ txsurg.f),
                           levels = c ("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),
         txhorm.f = factor(case_when(is.na(txhorm.f) ~ "Unknown",
                                     TRUE ~ txhorm.f),
                           levels = c ("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),
         txrad.f = factor(case_when(is.na(txrad.f) ~ "Unknown",
                                     TRUE ~ txrad.f),
                           levels = c ("No", "Yes", "Unknown")),
         psa.f = factor(case_when(is.na(psa.f) ~ "Unknown",
                                     TRUE ~ psa.f),
                           levels = c ("<10", "10-20", "20+", "Unknown")))

```

```{r PFAS}
table1_PFAS |>

```

## Overall

```{r table 1 overall}
table1 <- df_table1_diagnosis |>
  table1_design(pfoa, dxage, age_cat.f,  dxyr_cat.f, nhrace, married.f, insur.f, grade_combo.f, stage.f, mets, txsurg.f, txhorm.f, txrad.f, psa.f, nses_quin, psa_perc, no2_new, pm25_new, ndvi27_final, continuous_type = "mean (sd)")

table1 |>
  rifttable(risk_digits = 1) |>
  rt_gt()
```

# Summary statistics of PFAS
```{r}
water_summary_long <- df_table1_diagnosis |>
  select(c(patient_study_id, pfoa, pfos, pfna)) |>
   pivot_longer(pfoa:pfna, names_to = "Analyte", values_to = "Value")

water_summary_long$Value <- as.numeric(water_summary_long$Value)

water_summary_long <- water_summary_long |>
  group_by(Analyte) %>%
  summarise(
    N      = n(),
    min    = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25     = quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean   = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75     = quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90    = quantile(Value, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(mean)

knitr::kable(water_summary_long, format="markdown")
```
